_comment: Template for real local expert configs.
Copy this file, fill in your actual model paths/tags, and pass it to MoK.
Fields with null are optional — remove or fill in as needed.
'ollama'    — requires Ollama running at api_url (default: http://localhost:11434)
'mock'      — always-available stub for testing; ignores api_url and model_path
vram_cost_gb: peak VRAM while this expert is resident (estimate from quantization).
ram_cost_gb : approximate system RAM consumed (usually smaller than VRAM).
Quantization VRAM rough guide (7B parameter model):
Q4_K_M~ 4.5 GB   Q3_K_M~ 3.5 GB   Q2_K  ~ 2.8 GB

experts._comment: Tiny always-resident coordinator for MoK planning/routing checks; keep under 1.2GB.
experts.name: coordinator

experts._comment: Code specialist — routed to by R0 on code/debug/test prompts.
experts.name: coder

experts._comment: Tiny general MoK lane using the same <=1.2GB local model as the coordinator.
experts.name: general

experts._comment: Vision expert — multimodal model served via Ollama. Replace base_id with your vision model.
experts.name: vision
